security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://capture.localhost; img-src 'self' blob: data: http://capture.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

bundle.shortDescription: Fast, free screen capture and markup
bundle.longDescription: A fast, free screen capture and markup tool for Windows. Press a shortcut, select an area, draw on it, and it's on your clipboard. Every tool remembers your settings, every picker can be tailored to your workflow, and almost everything has a keyboard shortcut.
